summary.text: Western Desert Zombie Alliance's inheritance is the store of resources still left deep within translocation desert, which Fang Yuan sets out to take and other Western Desert Gu Immortals hunt for.

claims.text: Newly in Western Desert, Fang Yuan reflects that Western Desert’s Zombie Alliance was destroyed but a lot of resources remain deep within translocation desert, and he resolves to rush there. Rank six Gu Immortal Fiend Mosquito tails Three Feather Boy beneath translocation desert, hoping to find Corpse City of Zombie Alliance. Three Feather Boy sends him into an earth qi sandstorm to test what he calls the defensive formation of Western Desert Zombie Alliance’s branch, and Fiend Mosquito’s screams soon stop.

Western Desert Zombie Alliance’s inheritance is hidden in translocation desert. Corpse City, where the branch’s resources sit, is a city made from yellow clay that is actually a huge mortal Gu House. When Shadow Sect activated its hundred thousand year plan to defy heaven and refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu, it lost nearly everything. The blessed land base of the branch was discarded, the resources inside were hidden in Corpse City, the entire mortal Gu House was moved to underneath translocation desert, and a defensive Gu formation was activated.

Not long after the Battle of Yi Tian Mountain, Western Desert Gu Immortals broke into the former earth path blessed land and plundered it, but they did not get the loot they planned to get. After constant investigation and deduction, along with the secret help of heaven’s will, they found translocation desert and confirmed that the inheritance was hidden there. Finding the exact cave is not easy, because the caves are numerous like the stars in the sky and constantly moving, with old caves vanishing while new caves appear.

Fairy Cui Bo, who says she came on the orders of Thousand Transformations Ancestor, proposes sharing this Zombie Alliance treasure with Fang Yuan, but he says he will take the inheritance, lets Bai Ning Bing, Hei Lou Lan, and Fairy Miao Yin out of his immortal aperture, and orders them to kill her and Three Feather Boy. As the leader of Shadow Sect, Fang Yuan finds it simple to get into Corpse City, and he moves the entire city into his immortal aperture. Corpse City does not have Immortal Gu stored up, but its defensive Gu formation uses Immortal Gu as the core, two in total, and one of them is Fang Yuan’s main objective on this journey.

The two Immortal Gu are the rule path rank seven Fight, which looks like a rhinoceros beetle and is Fang Yuan’s biggest gain this time, and the earth path rank six Yellow Sand, which looks like a ladybug with a round carapace bearing six yellow stars. Fang Yuan quickly refines Fight and keeps it in his immortal aperture. Western Desert Zombie Alliance created the defensive Gu formation from Fight, Yellow Sand, some mortal Gu, the dense earth qi inside the caves, and earth path dao marks, and it breaks apart and collapses as Fang Yuan gathers the Gu worms into his immortal aperture.

The treasury of Corpse City holds lots of immortal materials. The most precious is cold moon divine bravery, a rank seven immortal material condensed from moonlight at the center of the desert over ten thousand years, priceless inside treasure yellow heaven and so few in quantity that even rank eight Gu Immortals do not have much. The one with the most quantity is phosphorescent wood, a rank six immortal material that grows in fierce ghost desert in the territory of Western Desert Zombie Alliance, the accumulation of the branch after countless years.

Ying Wu Xie and his companions have already visited the other branches, and the Zombie Alliance inheritance of Central Continent, Northern Plains, and Southern Border has already been used up, while Eastern Sea Gu Immortals have taken over the Eastern Sea branch and are in control of it. The final Western Desert inheritance is now in Fang Yuan’s hands, the final bit of fortune that Shadow Sect had.

Bai Ning Bing returns with Fairy Cui Bo captured and frozen, Fang Yuan has her keep the captive in her immortal aperture, and Hei Lou Lan reports that Three Feather Boy was burned to ashes. Then Peacock Deity, Beautiful Camel Immortal, and Dong Lie Feng, three rank seven Gu Immortals of Western Desert, appear around Fang Yuan. Beautiful Camel Immortal demands that he leave them a portion of Zombie Alliance’s inheritance, and then all three shout that he hand it over and they might spare his group. In their minds the inheritance belongs to them. Dong Lie Feng recognizes Fang Yuan as Liu Guan Yi and flees, then Beautiful Camel Immortal and Peacock Deity flee as well, so that all three leave in fear before Fang Yuan does anything.

When Thousand Transformations Ancestor learns that Fairy Cui Bo is in trouble, he names two possibilities for the attack, one of them that the inheritance of Western Desert Zombie Alliance’s branch was too alluring and its value so tremendous that greed led to killing intent.

Ying Wu Xie, speaking as Fairy Cui Bo, tells Thousand Transformations’ will and Dancer Hong Yun that she was trying to find Western Desert Zombie Alliance’s inheritance when she met Heavenly Court’s Gu Immortals, who seemed to know she was Thousand Transformations Ancestor’s concubine. The story is a mix of truths and lies.

Corpse City, the mortal Gu House Fang Yuan obtained from Western Desert’s translocation desert, stands in Mini Western Desert inside his immortal aperture. Most of its immortal materials have been traded to Thousand Transformations’ will, and little remains.

Location.text: Corpse City, hidden in translocation desert
